local_entities.label: Q Continuum manifestation presented as roadside setting

evidence.summary: The imprisoned Q asks to die, describes endless immortality as intolerable, and requests asylum so the Continuum cannot prevent his mortality.
Voyager participants enter a comprehensible roadside-style manifestation used to represent the Continuum rather than an ordinary literal location.
Competing Q and temporarily summoned witnesses give conflicting accounts of the prisoner's influence, immortality, social stagnation, and consequences of permitting death.
Historical witnesses are temporarily brought into the hearing context and later returned with memories removed, making their testimony source-relative to a Q-mediated event.
Janeway grants asylum after finding the prisoner rational and suffering intolerably, prioritizing individual autonomy over predicted social disruption.
The prisoner loses Q powers, becomes mortal, and enters Voyager's manifest under the name Quinn.
Quinn ingests Nogatch hemlock and dies after thanking Janeway for making mortality possible.
Q admits obtaining the fatal poison for Quinn and characterizes Quinn's death as a lesson that changed his own thinking.

assertions.subject: voy-dw:q_prisoner
assertions.object: right to become mortal and die

assertions.subject: voy-dw:continuum_manifest
assertions.object: Q Continuum experience made comprehensible to Voyager participants

neutral_coding.plot_problem: A Q prisoner's request for mortality becomes an asylum hearing about individual autonomy and consequences for an immortal society.
neutral_coding.epistemics: Claims about Continuum society and historical influence remain testimony; the roadside setting is coded as a manifestation frame.
neutral_coding.identity_continuity: Q prisoner and mortal Quinn are connected by a work-local state transition rather than assumed globally identical across every continuity dimension.
neutral_coding.counterevidence: Predicted social consequences are argued by witnesses but are not observable outcomes within the hearing itself.
